findings: [P2] packages/cadenda/server.py: approval_preview() returns approval_target() directly, including unredacted Beads Issue fields and verified decision comments from requirement_binding(). Existing credential-bearing source text therefore reaches the browser, unlike issue_detail(), context, artifact and run responses. Preserve the fingerprint over the original target, but redact the displayed response before serialization. Add a test placing credential patterns in existing Issue fields and decision comments and asserting they are absent from the preview response.

[P2] web/src/main.jsx: Job polling lacks a target/generation check. If a /jobs response is pending when openIssue() clears job, its eventual setJob(v) restores the old job and starts polling again; its output can appear under a different Issue. Track the job target and request generation, invalidate them when clearing or changing the Issue, and discard stale responses. Add a delayed-response test that switches Issues before releasing the old job response.
requirements_checked: Reviewed supplied source only; used no tools and did not independently verify supplied test results.
Checked pairing possession, single use, session expiry/logout, cookie settings, Host/Origin and CSRF enforcement; actor names and AI verdicts were not treated as owner authentication.
Checked request bounds, routing, fixed launch arguments, cancellation/resume, SSE cursors and React asynchronous state integrity.
Checked immutable artifact binding, stale/tampered approvals, challenge expiry/replay protection and authenticated decision receipt verification.
The prior start-dialog fingerprint finding is addressed by capturing the target and fingerprint in modal state.
Excluded simultaneous external Beads writes and Phase 7 requirements as specified.
